assumptions: The continuous wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, slip-ratio, and PID computations are abstracted outside this discrete FSM; the DSL treats `slp` as the supervisor input representing the slip-error/PID-driven decision variable.
The state output assignments are modeled as leaf-state `during` actions so valve and pump commands are maintained while each FSM state is active.

M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

scenario_results.description: default-init probe: first empty cycle dispatches to increase and asserts inlet-valve increase outputs k1=1, k2=0, n=0.
scenario_results.name: default_init_reaches_increase_outputs

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: increase transitions to hold exactly when slp <= 0.01 and hold neutralizes both valves.
scenario_results.name: increase_to_hold_at_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start no-fire probe: increase must not transition to hold when slp is just above 0.01.
scenario_results.name: increase_stays_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: hold transitions to increase when slp > 0.01 and increase asserts pressure-increase outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_increase_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start boundary no-fire probe: hold must not transition to increase when slp is exactly 0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_stays_at_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: hold transitions to decrease when slp < -0.01 and decrease asserts return-valve and pump release outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_decrease_below_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start boundary no-fire probe: hold must not transition to decrease when slp is exactly -0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_stays_at_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start boundary probes: decrease stays releasing below -0.01, but transitions to hold exactly when slp >= -0.01.
scenario_results.name: decrease_lower_boundary_fire_and_no_fire

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: decrease transitions to hold when slp is exactly -0.01 and hold neutralizes both valves.
scenario_results.name: decrease_to_hold_at_lower_boundary

findings.summary: The PID/slip computation and wheel-speed/vehicle-speed signal derivation mentioned in the NL are not modeled internally; they are abstracted into the external input `slp`. This is acceptable for a discrete-supervisor candidate but prevents treating the model as a full coupled ABS controller.

evidence: No variables or states for PID terms, wheel speed, vehicle speed, or plant dynamics
sim_summary scenarios exercise threshold transitions and state outputs only

findings.summary: The model is a compact abstraction of the supervisor only. It does not encode PID state, saturation, sampling, wheel dynamics, or hydraulic plant dynamics, so simulation success only validates the discrete threshold map.
